remarks: Nestled in one of the most sought-after areas in Fairfield County, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 2 and a half bath West Norwalk property is the perfect blend of timeless elegance, everyday comfort, and modern convenience. Situated near the New Canaan border and set on 1.4 flat, professionally landscaped acres, this meticulously maintained home delivers privacy, space, and a lifestyle designed for both family living and effortless entertaining. From the moment you arrive, the home's quintessentially New England presence and beautifully manicured grounds surrounded by charming stone walls create a warm and welcoming first impression. Inside, thoughtfully designed living spaces offer an ideal balance of sophistication and functionality. At the heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen, beautifully appointed with stunning marble countertops, premium high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous prep space-perfect for everything from busy weekday mornings to holiday gatherings and family celebrations. Up a few steps from the kitchen, the spacious sun-drenched family room creates the ideal everyday gathering space, filled with warmth and natural light. Formal living room and dining room with fireplace provide elegant settings for entertaining, holiday dinners, and special occasions, while the solarium with its floor-to-ceiling multi-paned windows offers a peaceful and stunning extension of the living space, perfect for morning coffee, reading, or simply enjoying the surroundin
